# UNS Collection, Record, Sample and explicit relations

| Object | Meaning | Relationship |
| --- | --- | --- |
| directory | Tree folder | parentId references a directory; 1:N children |
| topic | Tree leaf | records mode N:1 Collection; fields mode references fixed Record/Sample fields |
| collection | Dataset and Schema definition | 1:N Records; independent of tree placement |
| Record | Current business row or measurement definition | Composite collectionId + id identity |
| Sample | Measurement history | Composite collectionId + recordId reference; Record 1:0..N Sample |

IDs are strings; API time values are Unix milliseconds. Latest Sample ordering uses business time, not reception time. Missing sampling, null, zero and false remain distinct.

Read Collection definitions with the current catalog's Collection tools; read data through Collection-scoped records:find/aggregate/count/distinct and samples:find/aggregate/latest. Discover actual tool names through api_operations_list. Sample find/aggregate support multiple optional recordIds and require explicit from/to; latest requires explicit recordIds. Query paths use bare business fields and _id/_meta.*, while ordinary resource responses keep business values under data. Aggregate output follows the pipeline. See the [data contract](tier0://mcp/skill-docs/doc/uns-v2/data-api.md).

Topic fields use explicit kind + collectionId + recordId + fieldPath bindings for one object's current fields. They do not infer multi-row joins from names. The references tool reads only stored Topic bindings, Source instance mappings and App grants; hidden references are flagged without disclosure.

Both schemas and data require `uns.read`. Credentials and credential-like business values are redacted. App Collection grants need `uns.app.read`; passing an App ID never expands authorization.
